sentences.text:
Order 
This is the fifth bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail.

The applicant is in custody since 27.08.2022 in connection with Crime No.406/2022 registered at Police Station - Dharmapuri, District Dhar (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under section 409 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code of 1860.

2 As per prosecution story, on 27.08.2022 complainant Amit lodged an FIR at P.S. Dharmpuri, Dhar by stating that present applicant Gokul told him that he is doing trading work in M.L.M. Chit Fund Company, if he invests the amount in the company he will return him double amount.

Therefore, he has invested more than Rs.87,27,500/- to the applicant but only Rs.66,66,649/- have been returned to him and applicant did not return the remaining amount of Rs.20,61,151/- and cheated and committed criminal NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:23251 2 MCRC-34412-2024 breech of trust with him.
3 Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is an innocent person and he has been falsely implicated in this offence.

He is in custody since 27.8.2022, although his two bail applications have been dismissed on merit but thereafter investigating officer Inspector K.S.
Mandloi has been examined before the trial court, he was additionally examined by the Presiding Officer of trial court and on the basis of his statement, it is clear that police did not done investigation and charge sheet has been filed on the basis of statement of complainant and Gokul vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12646365/

Final conclusion of the trial is likely to take sufficient long time.
Under the above changed circumstances, prayer for grant of bail may be considered on such terms and conditions, as this Court deems fit and proper.

4 Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent / State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection by submitting that earlier two bail applications of applicant have been dismissed on merit, there is no material change in the circumstances, prosecution witness is going on,hence he does not deserve for bail.
5 Perused the impugned order of the trial Court as well as the case diary.

6 After considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, nature and gravity of offence,
arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant, it is revealed that all grounds raised by applicant have already been NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:23251 3 MCRC-34412-2024 considered at the earlier stage, the earlier two bail applications of applicant have been dismissed on merit, although Presiding officer of trial court has examined the witness K.S.
Mandloi, but at the stage of consideration of bail, detail marshalling of witness is not permissible as per the judgment of Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satish Jaggi Vs. State of Chhattisgarh and Ors.
